title: Say Ilog ya Angiparungtal na Puso
intro: Imadyin mo so sakey ya armada ya onkukurang, napgaan tan nasusubok, ya say sakey a ganggan ed gilig na ilog et mangibiig ed determinasyon tan pilalek. Say pinilin lider so mangigiya ed saray rangko ya mamaarap ed mabiskeg a kalaban, ya manmamatalek ed si Allah labat.
clues: Siak so tinuro nen Allah bilang lider na saray anak na Israel kayari dan kinmerew na sakey a milaban ed dalan To.
Niiter ed siak so daakan a pikakabat tan inkatagey bilang tanda na inkapili ko, anggaman kinuestion na saray totook so autoridad ko.
Linma ak a kaiba iray puersa tan imbagak ed sikara ya suboken ira nen Allah panamegley na ilog.
Impasakbay ko ya siopaman ya oninum ed satan et ag magmaliw ya kayarian ko, likud ed samay makaala na daiset.
Binmaliw ak a kaiba so pigaran nansiansian malet, ya akaarap ed armada a mas dakel so bilang da.
Indaulo ko iramay angibaga no panon kabetbet ya natalo na melag a grupo so baleg diad panamegley na permiso nen Allah, antis ya atalo so Jalut.

options: As-Samiri

options: Manggagawa na biong antis na delap

trial.answer: Panubok ed armada panamegley na ilog antis na bakal

options: Man-akmon ed dalin a walaan na kayamanan

outcome.answer: Say impanalo lapud inabuloyan nen Allah tan si Jalut so pinatey nen Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
